Description:
Expected outcome: Record topic and scope agreement.
Acceptance criteria: Record agreed scope and remaining academic details; retain approval reference.

Expected outcome: Validate user evidence route.
Acceptance criteria: Record 3–5 real discussions/client agreement or an explicit authorised alternative; separate examples.

Expected outcome: Record user findings.
Acceptance criteria: Anonymised findings link to requirement changes; no invented participant records.

Expected outcome: Review literature analysis.
Acceptance criteria: Check eleven scientific studies and explain relevant limitations.

Expected outcome: Review existing systems.
Acceptance criteria: Three systems use ten common criteria with source links.

Expected outcome: Review technology and model alternatives.
Acceptance criteria: Compare current stack and Llama/Gemma/Nemotron; separate hypotheses from measurements.

Expected outcome: Review baseline requirements.
Acceptance criteria: All 34 requirements have priority, status and acceptance checks.

Expected outcome: Review current architecture diagrams.
Acceptance criteria: Context, use case and components match source; editable/export files open.

Expected outcome: Rehearse working interface.
Acceptance criteria: Upload, review, save and DOCX shown on target host; current limitations stated.

Expected outcome: Review evaluation protocol.
Acceptance criteria: Data splits, metrics, baselines and resource conditions fixed before testing.

Expected outcome: Restore YouTrack team access.
Acceptance criteria: Three real accounts access the project; URL supplied and issues assigned.

Expected outcome: Obtain substantive supervisor review.
Acceptance criteria: Actual comments and resulting revisions recorded; draft is confirmed or replaced.

Expected outcome: Document hackathon provenance.
Acceptance criteria: Baseline commit, inherited work and account/name mapping documented.

Expected outcome: Verify local deployment boundary.
Acceptance criteria: Loopback run and absence of public role claims verified.

Expected outcome: Verify upload and context handling.
Acceptance criteria: Formats, limit, invalid metadata and unsafe filenames checked.

Expected outcome: Verify worker and retry recovery.
Acceptance criteria: Interrupted job and failed-only retry behavior reproduced.

Expected outcome: Compare ASR candidates.
Acceptance criteria: Same-data WER/CER for current mixed-CTC and feasible Whisper alternatives.

Expected outcome: Evaluate speakers and evidence links.
Acceptance criteria: DER and source-link validity measured; mapping errors analysed.

Expected outcome: Implement extractive evaluation baseline.
Acceptance criteria: Fixed cue rules evaluated on held-out transcripts without test-set tuning.

Expected outcome: Compare generation candidates.
Acceptance criteria: Current Qwen and feasible alternatives use identical evaluation examples; infeasible models labelled.

Expected outcome: Verify review persistence and conflicts.
Acceptance criteria: Original preserved, edits survive restart, stale revision returns conflict.

Expected outcome: Verify DOCX output.
Acceptance criteria: Saved content and Kazakh characters verified in rendered exports.

Expected outcome: Verify library and processing visibility.
Acceptance criteria: Persisted meetings and actual stages/errors displayed accurately.

Expected outcome: Confirm data permission and retention.
Acceptance criteria: Hackathon reuse/publication permissions checked and cleanup policy recorded.

Expected outcome: Test malformed and adversarial input.
Acceptance criteria: Input text cannot execute tasks; invalid result fails clearly.

Expected outcome: Run frozen bilingual evaluation.
Acceptance criteria: Results, failures, data counts and exact experiment manifests retained.

Expected outcome: Run paired usability study.
Acceptance criteria: 6–8 users or disclosed actual sample; active time and quality compared.

Expected outcome: Verify performance and accessibility.
Acceptance criteria: Declared-host latency/memory and keyboard/small-screen checks documented.

Expected outcome: Review and tag first submission.
Acceptance criteria: Peer-reviewed merged commit tagged pre-defense-1 with limitations.

Expected outcome: Prepare final defense evidence.
Acceptance criteria: Individual contributions and completed experiments traceable; actual defense date confirmed.

Expected outcome: Assess live ingestion feasibility.
Acceptance criteria: Provider/room-capture permission, budget and scope decision documented.

Expected outcome: Prototype live extension if approved.
Acceptance criteria: Ordered provisional text, gaps and measured latency; no claim before implementation.

Summary: Review future revision and role contracts
Description:
Expected outcome: Review future revision and role contracts.
Acceptance criteria: Explicit decision on full history/shared approval; changes require agreed contract.
